events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: What's your favourite Liam Gallagher track, whether it's from Oasis, Beady Eye, or his solo career? We're celebrating the iconic frontman's 54th today.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' is 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine', featuring his signature song, was released in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. What does a world without possessions, heaven, or hell look like to you?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the revolutionary first-generation iPod in 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? It's 25 years since Apple put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 by asking: who's your favourite Bond actor and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the eclectic masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. Which track from the double LP is your essential listen?

events.title: 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, 35 years on from his passing. A voice and a showman like no other.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood', was released in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album that pushed boundaries and delivered timeless classics. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since we lost a true visionary. His music and spirit live on.
